Subject: PO handoff: merchant onboarding — itemization clarity and provisional PO

Hi Alicia / Kestrel team,

Thanks again for completing the onboarding form this morning — welcome aboard. Monica and I reviewed the intake and noticed two items we need clarified before we can finalize issuance of the purchase reference:

1) Line item breakdown: the draft budget lists a single line for "Platform fees" but our ledger requires distinct SKUs for "Hosted API usage" and "Support retainer" so we can assign to different cost centers.
2) Spend cap: the onboarding form lists a monthly cap of $40k but the PO draft has $45k in the header — please confirm which figure Kestrel expects.

Attached: onboarding_form_kestrel.pdf and draft_PO_7862.pdf (provisional).

Can you confirm the preferred line split and the correct monthly cap by EOD so we can issue a provisional PO? If you prefer, we can schedule a 15-minute call to walk through.

Thanks,
Diego
Senior GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
---

Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO handoff: merchant onboarding — itemization clarity and provisional PO

Thanks Diego — great to be moving quickly.

Short answers:
- We can split the single "Platform fees" line into two SKUs: KP-API-USAGE (Hosted API usage) and KP-SUPPORT (Support retainer). Please use those descriptions.
- The correct monthly cap for our procurement team is $40,000 (the $45k was an internal estimate that shouldn't have been on the draft).

I've asked Marco in billing to produce an updated PO reflecting those two line items and the $40k cap; he'll attach the file shortly.

Alicia
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Kestrel Payments
